CLI-JSON.description: Exactly one UTF-8 JSON document; no stdout prose or terminal escapes

CLI-INPUT.description: Non-TTY invocation must finish without reading interactive input

CLI-HELP.description: Help and version are discoverable without configuration

CLI-COLOR.description: Piped output is uncolored and does not invoke a pager

CLI-VALIDATE.description: Reject invalid input before performing side effects

CLI-SECRETS.description: Diagnostics must not echo secret configuration values

AXV-SCHEMA.description: Schema-2 fields, typed errors and exit mapping
